meta.notes: DRAFT by Claude (s348) for Ben. RENAME (Ben s348): the old HOME PLANET is now SHASTA, a SNOW WORLD WITH MOUNTAINS. There is a NEW player planet (not this one; built later). Clubhouse 8 stays here. The player's place is a FLAT INSIDE an apartment block (Summit View Apartments), not its own house. The 2D files use gaya… keys for these rooms: each building/zone keeps its 2D key in "room2d". SHASTA = an alpine snow town in a valley under MOUNT SHASTA. The CROSS-SHAPED square (two avenues) has an OUTDOOR SKATING RINK where they cross (transport pad beside it). N: North Avenue past the shrine, Snow Watch, Avalanche & Fire, Snowpost, Infirmary to the white castle + barracks; royal court EAST of the castle. E: Lodge Road to the SKI LODGE plaza (Bram's Ski Works, Mountain Hut, fire, chair lift) and up the mountain: SLOPES, GLOW-WORM GROTTO, SNOW FORT. S: the glassy SHASTA LAKE (jetty, pontoon, drone range), Snowberry Farm. W: West Avenue (Stadium Path) to THE RINK + Curling Club, the playground, Sled & Skate Hire. Mountains ring the whole valley. EVERY BUILDING IS UNIQUE ("outside" note), roof sign + eye-level door sign.

buildings.label: Clubhouse 8
buildings.note: 8 ARCADE CABINETS (4 each wall), COUNTER (shifts: A Quiet Hour, The Evening Rush; token + item sales), banner + crest, lounge, 8 lamps. Pip at front of house.
buildings.outside: The town's signature: a dark timber arcade lodge with a giant glowing 8 in a ring on the roof, neon cabinet silhouettes in the frosted windows, a red carpet under a snow canopy.

buildings.label: Tavern
buildings.note: Bar (5 stools), AIR HOCKEY table, jukebox, darts, 2 tables, barrels, torches. Barkeep Sorrel, Grish the explorer, Volley, Pip. Pizza delivery stop.
buildings.outside: Big log tavern with a steep snow-loaded roof, a stone chimney puffing smoke, icicles along the eaves, a giant air-hockey puck + mallet sign over the door.

buildings.label: Pizza Place
buildings.note: Sal's two-oven kitchen: OVEN MINIGAME (Sal's Round). Pizza DELIVERY runs start here (NOT BUILT YET in 3D).
buildings.outside: Red brick pizzeria with 2 brick oven domes glowing through round windows, a spinning pizza on the roof, a delivery sled parked by the door.

buildings.label: Bramble's Comics
buildings.note: SUPERFOX + IRONFOX standees over SHELF SCREENS. Bramble. Pizza delivery stop.
buildings.outside: UNIQUE SPECIALTY SHOP: a pop-art front in bright blue + yellow, a giant SUPERFOX cut-out bursting through the roof sign, comic-panel windows.

buildings.label: Armory
buildings.outside: Stone forge cottage with an iron-shuttered window, a glowing forge vent melting a ring in the snow, crossed halberds over the door.

buildings.label: Item Shop
buildings.note: Shopkeeper Fenn: Heal Beam Battery, Energy Cell, Box of Chocolates, Keeper's Draught.
buildings.outside: General store with a wraparound porch, sleds + snowshoes for sale out front, a lit lantern sign shaped like a gift box.

buildings.label: Relic Museum
buildings.note: 10 GLASS CASES for relics, centre table, archivist desk, 2 globes, 4 braziers. Quill the curator.
buildings.outside: Round white stone ROTUNDA with a copper dome gone green, columns round the front, 4 braziers on the steps.

buildings.label: Foxy Cakes
buildings.outside: UNIQUE RESTAURANT: a pink-and-cream bakery like a frosted layer cake (white icing drips along the roof edge), a giant cupcake with a candle on top.

buildings.label: Summit View Apartments
buildings.note: Ben s348: the player's place is a FLAT INSIDE this apartment block (YOUR PLACE: bed/rest, plinth + trophy wall, table, TV, couch, kitchen, window, posters). Neighbours live in the other flats.
buildings.outside: 4-storey timber + stone APARTMENT BLOCK: wooden balconies with snow on the rails, a lit stairwell tower, YOUR LANDING sign by the door. The PLAYER'S APARTMENT is one flat inside (2nd floor, the gold door).

buildings.label: Toy Workshop
buildings.outside: Crooked gingerbread-style workshop: candy-stripe trim, a big wind-up key turning on the roof, toy trains in the window.

buildings.label: Chess Club
buildings.outside: Black-and-white chequered stone front, a giant knight piece on the roof, a tall arched window with a board inside.

buildings.label: Checkers Club
buildings.outside: Round red cabin with a flat drum roof stacked like checkers pieces (red + black), a crown on top.

buildings.label: Galactic Post Office (Meru Embassy)
buildings.outside: Timber post house with a clock tower + Meru flag, a mail sled rack, the Galactic Post dish frosted on the roof.

buildings.label: Glacier Bank
buildings.outside: Blue-grey granite with tall frosted glass, an ice-crystal crest over heavy brass doors, a round vault window.

buildings.label: Frost & Flint
buildings.note: SPECIAL WEAPONS: the 8 extra ranged + melee
buildings.outside: Slate-roofed stone shop, blue ice-crystal blade + laser sign, weapon racks behind frosted glass.

buildings.label: Pinecone Flats
buildings.outside: 3-storey apartment block with green shutters + pinecone carvings, window boxes of winter berries.

buildings.label: Icicle Row
buildings.outside: Tall narrow pale-blue row flats with long icicles, a rooftop greenhouse.

buildings.label: Chalet
buildings.outside: A-frame chalet with a deep snow roof, a sauna hut + log pile beside it.

buildings.label: Snow Watch
buildings.outside: Stone watch house with a blue lamp, a lookout bell tower, rescue skis hung on the wall.

buildings.label: Avalanche & Fire
buildings.outside: Red timber fire hall with a wide bay, a snowcat with a plough + a fire sled out front, a siren tower.

buildings.label: The Shasta Snowpost
buildings.note: PAPER ROUTE starts here (NOT BUILT YET)
buildings.outside: Tall narrow newsroom with a radio mast covered in rime ice, a news ticker under the roof sign, newspaper bundles on a sled.

buildings.label: Shasta Infirmary
buildings.outside: White timber hospital with red trim, a glass sunroom, a red cross on the roof, the medevac helipad beside it.

buildings.label: Throne Room
buildings.note: Castle hall; THRONE. King Grant, proudly average; Hope beside him (the NINE SEAMS).
buildings.outside: The grandest building: a white stone castle with tall blue slate spires dusted with snow, gold trim, ice-blue banners, a frozen waterfall beside the gate.

buildings.label: Barracks
buildings.note: Guard Captain, Master of Arms. Pizza delivery stop.
buildings.outside: Long grey stone guard hall with a snowy training yard, a bell, the crest banner on a pole.

buildings.label: The Rink
buildings.note: Ice, nets, benches, tunnel: 4-a-side vs The Cubs, The Pines, Iron Eight. Ref Furlong; skaters Fleet, Cinder, Bracken.
buildings.outside: UNIQUE SPORT: a big curved-roof ice arena, blue + white, a giant crossed hockey stick sign, glass walls glowing at night.

buildings.label: Curling Club
buildings.outside: Long low club house with 3 outdoor curling sheets behind it, a giant curling stone on the roof.

buildings.label: Sled & Skate Hire
buildings.note: Car rental Shasta style: sleds, snowmobile (DRAFT), ROCKET SKATES
buildings.outside: Bright yellow hire hut with skis, sleds, rocket skates + pogo sticks racked on the walls, a big sled-runner sign.

buildings.label: The Frost Vault
buildings.note: The famous Shasta relic to BUY (DRAFT: Ben picks)
buildings.outside: Tiny shop carved like a block of blue glacier ice, one relic frozen in a lit ice pillar in the window.

buildings.label: Bram's Ski Works
buildings.note: Ski rentals by the shed (2D); Bram waxes boards.
buildings.outside: Ski workshop with a huge ski + board crossed on the roof, a waxing bench on the porch, racks of skis in the snow.

buildings.label: Mountain Hut
buildings.outside: Tiny stone refuge with a turf roof under deep snow, a single glowing window, a kettle chimney.

buildings.label: Snowberry Farm
buildings.outside: Red barn + 2 glass greenhouse domes glowing warm, snowberry bushes, a reindeer-style fox sled.

gates.note: THE GLASS [gayaGlass] battle map: landing fight, defend the TRANSPORT CORE, arsenal, turret, tank + walker. 6 Sink Wardens, 3 Sink Sentries, 3 Sink Chargers (HACKED Machine Fleet: free them).
THE SNOW FORT [gayaSnowFort] high on the mountain: one way in, one way out, trench fort. 17 Fort Sentries, 17 Fort Guards, boss THE SNOW KING.
THE THREE ICE GATES on the slopes (Lower, Park, Far Seam; 240 HP each) spawn snowmen: 3 Icicle Snowmen, 2 Snowball Sentries.
DRAFT: FROST RIDGE: snow wolves + ice beetles (creatures) in the pines north-west
GLOW-WORM GROTTO [gayaMountainCave]: glowing cave with boat water. Wren the keeper, Barrow the boatman (feed pail). 12 Spitter Worms, 8 Burrower Worms, boss THE FED ONE. Take the SEAM STONE to Hope.

look.notes: SNOW WORLD WITH MOUNTAINS (Ben s348): crisp ice-blue sky to a white horizon, deep snow on every roof, snowy ground (the "grass" is snow), dark snow-dusted pines, glassy blue lake with ice at the edges. Timber + grey stone, gold-trimmed signs, lilac window boxes, warm amber windows + lanterns at night. Light snowfall, breath steam.

terrain.notes: SHASTA = a flat valley town ringed by MOUNTAINS. MOUNT SHASTA (the big peak) fills the north-east: the slopes, the Ice Gates, the Glow-Worm Grotto + the Snow Fort sit on it, reached by the CHAIR LIFT from the Ski Lodge. More peaks ring the valley (north-west, north, west, south-east, south). The town, the avenues and the lake shore stay flat.
